NAYA-BTN-009.name: Hero · Enter the Standard

ai_label.purpose: The Reference Button: a living button (.living-btn, elev-3) with a glow layer and the label 'ENTER THE STANDARD', carrying a full named motion spec (idle breathe, sheen sweep, hover lift, press sink) in the store.
ai_label.use_when: Use as the hero call-to-action — and as the crowned exemplar every other button's depth, glow, and press physics are copied from.

NAYA-BTN-009.motion: rest: idleBreathe 4.2s ease-in-out infinite + glow layer at opacity .55 + sheen sweep 5.5s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.22,1) infinite; hover: lift translateY(-4px) scale(1.025), transform/box-shadow .28s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.22,1), glow opacity → 1 over .3s; press: sink translateY(1px) scale(.975), transition-duration .08s (fast in, spring-feel return on the .28s ease); prefers-reduced-motion: breathe + sweep animations none — full outset stack and glow hold static
